name: Default
shortDescription: Web admin console for Synapse Matrix homeservers: manage users, rooms, media and reports through the Synapse admin API from your browser.

alerts.message: This is only the admin console: it needs an existing Synapse homeserver (v1.93.0 or newer) whose /_matrix and /_synapse/admin endpoints your browser can reach. Sign in with the homeserver URL and a Synapse server admin account.
